name: Totenkampf : Anime Waifus vs WW2 Zombies
detailed_description:
In the closing months of World War 2, an ancient ritual is performed to bring ancient warriors into our world. From each nation, anime girls are summoned from the Hyperborean dimension to fight as a representative of their people and infused with the soul of a mortal woman of the time. Unfortunately the ritual is interrupted, and dark forces leak through that corrupt the soldiers involved into zombies. With the world now on the brink for both sides, the girls unite to stop the zombie horde that threatens our world. 

Gameplay

Totenkampf is a classic round based survival 1st and 3rd person shooter with anime girls and magical elements to spice up the setting and gameplay. Each girl has her own elemental abilities, and can also gain more powers by exchanging points at altars that provide a small link to their world. Aquire powerful weapons from WW2 and combine the powers of both worlds to cut through countless waves of zombies.

Characters and Powers

There are 6 girls to play as, representing the USA, England, Russia, Germany, Italy, and Japan. Each has her own personality and unique element. All of them are fully voiced and will interact with other characters around them through dialogue. They make use of Ice, Fire, Electricity, Water, Earth, and Wind abilities. Many will work well together, so be sure to use them as a team!

Customization

You can change the outfits, headgear, and hairstyles of each character. You can also create your own character entirely, and customize her face, body type, and hair to your liking! Get new outfits and other customization items by unlocking achievements in-game!

Weapons

Fans of WW2 shooters will recognize almost all their favorites here! There are a total of over 30 guns to use in-game. From the staples like the MP-40, M1 Garand, Kar98k, and PPsH-41, to the rarer weapons like the TZ-45, Volkssturmgewehr, and FG-42. There's a huge variety to work with for any play style.

Other Features

  • Leaderboards

  • Matchmaking

  • Private lobbies

  • Up to 6 player matches

  • Achievements

  • In depth settings menus and optimized performance

  • Anime girls!

short_description: Fight waves of WW2 zombies as an interdimensional magical anime girl, alone, or with a team of up to 6! Customize your waifu's appearance and outfit, and wield a wide array of weapons and powers as you struggle to survive the undead horde.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America
*languages with full audio support
